1.t: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High

3.t: and Who ordained precisely and inspired accordingly

5.t: then reduces it to withered chaff

6.t: We will have you recite ˹the Quran, O Prophet,˺ so you will not forget ˹any of it˺

7.t: unless Allah wills otherwise. He surely knows what is open and what is hidden
7.tr: Illaa maa shaaa'al laah; innahoo ya'lamul jahra Wa-maa yakhfaa

8.t: We will facilitate for you the Way of Ease

9.t: So ˹always˺ remind ˹with the Quran˺—˹even˺ if the reminder is beneficial ˹only to some˺

10.t: Those in awe ˹of Allah˺ will be mindful ˹of it˺

11.t: But it will be shunned by the most wretched

12.t: who will burn in the greatest Fire

13.t: where they will not ˹be able to˺ live or die
13.tr: Summa laa yamootu feehaa Wa-laa yahyaa

14.t: Successful indeed are those who purify themselves

15.t: remember the Name of their Lord, and pray

16.t: But you ˹deniers only˺ prefer the life of this world

17.t: even though the Hereafter is far better and more lasting

18.t: This is certainly ˹mentioned˺ in the earlier Scriptures—

19.t: the Scriptures of Abraham and Moses
